body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> MAGELLAN introduced GPS device 'eXplorist 710' at The Digital Experience, America's largest and best attended consumer electronics media event, which was held annually on the eve of the International Consumer Electronics Show.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
